rungs.title: Junior Frontend Developer
rungs.summary: Learning HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the team's components.
rungs.knowledge: Knows semantic HTML, CSS layout and core JavaScript.
rungs.delivery: Builds components and pages from a design with review on everything.
rungs.leadership: Shows work early and asks designers and teammates when unsure.

rungs.title: Frontend Developer
rungs.summary: Builds accessible, responsive interfaces on their own.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in a framework, accessibility, responsive layout and browser tooling.
rungs.delivery: Ships a feature end to end with tests and light review.
rungs.leadership: Works closely with designers; explains trade-offs without jargon.

rungs.title: Senior Frontend Developer
rungs.summary: Owns the front end of a product and its performance.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in rendering, state, performance and security of the browser; knows the API behind it.
rungs.delivery: Owns the front end of a product: structure, quality and speed.
rungs.leadership: Reviews, mentors and agrees API shape with backend and design.

rungs.title: Frontend Lead
rungs.summary: Leads the front-end practice and its standards.
rungs.knowledge: Chooses frameworks and patterns for the whole front end and sees the full system.
rungs.delivery: Plans and delivers cross-team front-end work and sets the standards.
rungs.leadership: Leads a team's delivery and speaks for the front end in architecture decisions.

rungs.title: Principal Frontend Engineer
rungs.summary: The company's authority on the front end.
rungs.knowledge: Recognised expert who sets the long-term front-end direction.
rungs.delivery: Solves the hardest front-end problems and makes them reusable.
rungs.leadership: Indispensable advisor to product, design and engineering leads.
